answer: Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers attest only after verifying the bond and work history. A thousand fake identities become a hollow fable once bonding costs exceed any sybil reward, and a whisper of collusion triggers slashing that confiscates the entire stake. Attackers must burn real capital per identity, making mass fabrication economically irrational, while honest agents recover bonds on exit. The Agent0078 deployment anchors trust at XTEhtsmV94.
